project.name: Swedish Historical HTR Research Center
project.description: Exactly one real, shared, ground-truthed HTR asset exists in this repository at template-authoring time: tests/fixtures/htr/trolldomskommissionen_sample_line.jpg (a single line from Riksarkivet's trolldomskommissionen_lines dataset, 17th-century Swedish court-record handwriting) plus its ground-truth transcription .txt file. A separate, hand-authored (not genuine Transkribus vendor output -- see tests/fixtures/transkribus/README.md) PAGE XML fixture, sample_page.xml, supplies the page-level, non-corresponding Transkribus input. This is NOT a multi-document research corpus; see scope_caveats.

dataset.name: Baseline comparison fixtures
dataset.description: One shared line fixture + one hand-authored Transkribus PAGE XML fixture.

metric_definition.name: character_error_rate_raw
metric_definition.description: Levenshtein character edit distance / reference length, computed on the exact raw strings with no normalization applied to either side. Distinct from character_error_rate_normalized -- see that definition's description for what 'normalized' means here.

metric_definition.name: character_error_rate_normalized
metric_definition.description: Levenshtein character edit distance / reference length, after evaluation.metrics.normalize_text (Unicode NFC composition + whitespace-run collapse, no case folding) is applied to both reference and hypothesis. Reuses evaluation.metrics.compare_text -- not a reimplementation.

metric_definition.name: word_error_rate_raw
metric_definition.description: Word-level Levenshtein edit distance / reference word count, tokenized by str.split() on the raw, non-NFC-normalized strings.

metric_definition.name: word_error_rate_normalized
metric_definition.description: Word-level Levenshtein edit distance / reference word count, after evaluation.metrics.normalize_text is applied to both sides before tokenizing. Reuses evaluation.metrics.compare_text.

metric_definition.name: exact_line_accuracy
metric_definition.description: Fraction of index-aligned reference/hypothesis line pairs (after normalize_text on each line) that match exactly. Assumes the caller supplies reference and hypothesis lines in the same reading-order alignment -- it does not itself solve line alignment (see segmentation.py for that when ground-truth geometry exists).

metric_definition.name: exact_word_accuracy
metric_definition.description: 1 - (word substitutions + word deletions) / reference word count, after normalize_text. Distinct from 1 - word_error_rate_normalized: WER's numerator also counts insertions, so word accuracy and (1 - WER) diverge whenever the hypothesis contains inserted words.

metric_definition.name: character_insertions
metric_definition.description: Count of character-level insertion edits (normalized text), from the edit-operation-classifying Levenshtein backtrace in recognition.classify_char_edits.

metric_definition.name: character_deletions
metric_definition.description: Count of character-level deletion edits (normalized text).

metric_definition.name: character_substitutions
metric_definition.description: Count of character-level substitution edits (normalized text).

metric_definition.name: word_insertions
metric_definition.description: Count of word-token insertion edits (normalized text), from recognition.classify_word_edits.

metric_definition.name: word_deletions
metric_definition.description: Count of word-token deletion edits (normalized text).

metric_definition.name: word_substitutions
metric_definition.description: Count of word-token substitution edits (normalized text).

metric_definition.name: historical_feature_precision
metric_definition.description: Per HistoricalFeatureEvaluator: |matched hypothesis spans| / |all hypothesis spans|, set-based over normalized span text. One MetricResult per (feature_name, method_run).

metric_definition.name: historical_feature_recall
metric_definition.description: Per HistoricalFeatureEvaluator: |matched reference spans| / |all reference spans|.

metric_definition.name: historical_feature_f1
metric_definition.description: Harmonic mean of historical_feature_precision and historical_feature_recall.

metric_definition.name: region_precision
metric_definition.description: Matched hypothesis regions (IoU >= threshold, greedy one-to-one) / all hypothesis regions.

metric_definition.name: region_recall
metric_definition.description: Matched reference regions / all reference regions.

metric_definition.name: line_precision
metric_definition.description: Matched hypothesis text lines (IoU >= threshold, greedy one-to-one) / all hypothesis text lines.

metric_definition.name: line_recall
metric_definition.description: Matched reference text lines / all reference text lines.

metric_definition.name: mean_matched_iou
metric_definition.description: Mean axis-aligned bounding-box IoU over every matched (reference, hypothesis) pair -- not over unmatched geometry.

metric_definition.name: missed_line_rate
metric_definition.description: Reference lines with no matching hypothesis line (IoU >= threshold) / all reference lines.

metric_definition.name: duplicate_line_rate
metric_definition.description: Hypothesis lines whose best-IoU reference line already has a distinct best-matching hypothesis line (over-prediction of the same true line) / all hypothesis lines.

metric_definition.name: merged_line_rate
metric_definition.description: Hypothesis lines whose bounding box has IoU >= threshold with more than one reference line (under-segmentation: two true lines merged into one predicted line) / all hypothesis lines.

metric_definition.name: split_line_rate
metric_definition.description: Reference lines whose bounding box has IoU >= threshold with more than one hypothesis line (over-segmentation: one true line split into multiple predicted lines) / all reference lines.

metric_definition.name: reading_order_accuracy
metric_definition.description: Fraction of matched-pair combinations (over TextLine.reading_order_index) whose relative order agrees between reference and hypothesis (pairwise order concordance).

metric_definition.name: region_order_accuracy
metric_definition.description: Same as reading_order_accuracy, computed over Region.order_index instead of TextLine.reading_order_index.

metric_definition.name: crop_coverage
metric_definition.description: Sum over reference lines of that line's best single-crop intersection area, divided by total reference line area. Axis-aligned-bbox approximation: does not compute a true multi-crop union, so it is a lower bound on true coverage when crops overlap the same line.

metric_definition.name: crop_contamination
metric_definition.description: Sum over hypothesis crops of (crop area - that crop's best single-reference-line overlap), divided by total crop area -- how much of the produced crops falls outside any true line.

metric_definition.name: execution_time_ms
metric_definition.description: Evidence.execution_time_ms, aggregated verbatim -- no new timing capture, only what the adapter already recorded.

metric_definition.name: gpu_memory_mb
metric_definition.description: Evidence.gpu_memory_mb, aggregated verbatim.

experiment.name: Swedish Historical HTR Baseline Comparison
experiment.description: How do SATRN (Riksarkivet), Florence-2 (hoanghapham/vlm-htr fine-tuned OCR checkpoint), and Transkribus Swedish Lion I compare on Swedish historical handwriting recognition, under (a) a controlled line-level comparison where the local recognizers read byte-identical input crops, and (b) an end-to-end, page-level comparison where each method's own pipeline (including Transkribus's own segmentation, run outside this application) is used as-is?

End-to-end comparison: Transkribus's own (external, already-completed, not re-run by this application) segmentation is used as-is -- its PAGE XML fixture's TextRegion/TextLine/Coords geometry is exactly what Transkribus itself produced (or, for this hand-authored fixture, what stands in for it).
